actions: Type KQL: agent.name:"clin-ws-12" AND winlog.event_id:(10 OR 1 OR 11 OR 3)
Expand EID 10 event — note process.name and parent lsass.exe
Pivot to EID 11 event — note file path C:\Temp\debug.dmp
Pivot to EID 3 event — note destination.ip 10.1.1.10 port 445 (SMB lateral move)
hypothesis: Wazuh documents show rundll32.exe accessing LSASS, creation of C:\Temp\debug.dmp, and a subsequent SMB connection to 10.1.1.10:445. The ordered chain is consistent with credential dumping followed by lateral movement to the domain controller.
